pages.title: Linking
pages.text: Use it on a node, then on the target. Click the first node again to cancel.$(br2)$(bold)Shift-click$() clears that node's links.

pages.title: Range
pages.text: $(li)Core, small relay, feedthrough: $(bold)16$() blocks$(li)Large relay: $(bold)32$() blocks$(li)The shorter end decides$(li)Up to 16 links per node$(br2)Look at a node within 6 blocks to see its links and kW.

pages.title: Coolant
pages.text: It also links a reactor's Coolant Ports to its $(l:reactor/radiators)radiators$(/l). Those links are blue and never carry power.
Links survive reloads. A blocked link waits until the path is clear; breaking a node removes its links.
Copper, redstone and iron.$(br2)$(flavor)Not a magic wand. Engineering insists.$()
